name: Pick & Pop
idea: Same pick, but the screener pops out to shoot instead of rolling.
why: Everyone expects the screener to roll to the basket. Popping out to the 3-point line finds open space away from the crowd.
tryit: After you set the pick, step back behind the 3-point line with your hands up, ready to catch and shoot.

frames.say: This time our big player is {4}, who can also shoot from far away.
{4} runs up and sets a *pick* on {X1}.
{1} dribbles around the pick. {X4} leaves {4} to help stop {1}.
*Pop:* Instead of rolling to the basket, {4} steps out to the 3-point line.
{1} passes to {4}. {X4} is way too far away!
{4} drains the three! One pick, two choices: roll to the rim or pop out and shoot.
